ns2:course.label: Project Management
ns2:course.description: In-depth treatment of management concepts, tools, and techniques that apply to the organization, planning, and control of projects; particular emphasis on analyzing needs, defining work, scheduling tasks, allocating resources; assessing costs, managing risks; tracking and evaluating performance; and building and leading teams.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to College of Business. Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
